scope: Laguna S 2.1 Q4_K_M T16 D8 selected gate/up wave-column remap on gfx1151

repo.qualification: Candidate measurements were made in the implementation worktree; selector-unset clean production publication remains required.

candidate.mapping: four wave32 groups each own 32 output columns and all 32 rows
candidate.weight_path: each even lane decodes one adjacent T16 column pair; wave shuffle distributes the high-nibble column; decoded weights remain in registers
candidate.arithmetic: unchanged split16 packed dots and K32 accumulation order
candidate.resident_layout: unchanged T16; no sidecar or transpose

validation.red: The candidate fixture failed on the missing wave_cols wrapper ABI.
validation.focused_green: Seven Q4 D4/D8 configurations passed, including BF16 byte equality between wave-column and production row-vector D8; the complete focused kernel/runtime/backend/category/publication/profile bundle reported 81 passes.
validation.correctness_gate: Independent CPU-reference KL <=0.05 and top-1 >=90%; wave-column output is BF16 byte-identical to production on the uneven/empty-expert fixture.

leaf.scope: actual layer-1 gate/up weights and frozen natural pp512 routing; BF16-to-D8 pack included

full_model.scope: one resident owner; matrix512/attention128; one 128-row warmup per mode; seven counterbalanced synchronized pp512 repetitions
